reviews.classification: multi-round source scope, local rights and optional human review reconciled
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers375input lines, all three rounds/windows/review ledgers, F1–F29, nine engine-fact rows, A1–A11, currencies/facilities/roles/contradictions/gaps and current source limits. Round2helper windows sum61669 and round3 sum52464words; mixed keyword excerpts remain search-level, not whole chapters or whole novel. Round2has35ledger rows,27wholly matched and8with uncertainty/unverified scope; round3has25rows,20opened/corrected/coordinator checks and5unverified, not24checked plus five more. Its blue-liquid price error is corrected in the existing derived owner. MTL snapshot and sid/paragraph identity, original-language U and compilation gaps remain separate; no raw source body was newly read.

F2: F9’s later user correction keeps derived-world institutions in Paradise content, with local/provided/restricted and source-era tags. A local hall is not automatically a hub building; that does not prove it unreachable through every actual travel edge. Guild-local board atsid4594 is not evidence no mission service exists under any wording. Narrow literal scans/no queue/no tuition/no staff to inspected source scope. F29’s school absence row is unverified beyond the stated fee/referral spot check, so fee-free teaching is not established. The existing derived owner already separates local guild board, gene potion and hub services; preserve that rather than dropping derived content.

F3: Tier, imprint/access level, Hunter office, Honor Shop level, permission expenditure, title, mission grade, body/stat requirements and Void Tree credit have distinct suppliers/consumers. Selected notices pair rights/duties but do not prove every tier step has the same bundle. Status conversion, possible restored Hunter role, entry rights and leave intervals remain speaker/era-qualified; first-mission failure and three failed promotions are different routes. Origin leave, derived-world obligation, hub rest, refresh and trial duration are different clocks. No evidence here makes every failed mission death, all staff immune, or every hub threat harmless. Alias concealment is a scoped permission claim, not proof against every observer.

F4: Paradise Coins, Soul Coins, graded crystals, Honor medals, Temporal Power, War Merit, local contribution/merit wording, Active Ore mass and gold pounds/coins remain distinct. Blue gene liquid15000CPpluspost, Smashing Fairy13000CPpluspost/reference3800PC and TypeC8000CPpluspost are separate items; a reference price does not define a universal exchange. Promotion counters, local balance and source-reported rank retention differ; unresolved10000/130000threshold and six-versus-seven naming stay gaps. A hidden negative credit rating is standing/access evidence, not an actual debt principal or payment obligation. Exact round-era quotes, material quantities, discounts, offers, paid purchases and source-dependent conversion eligibility stay attributed.

F5: Hall entry, earned points, image instruction, dangerous upgrade trial, actual absorption reward, purchased medicine, chosen anesthesia, repair, body function and source-supported permanent growth are separate. One observed three-to-seven stat gap does not identify a universal cap-removal trigger. Teacher image is not a living source teacher or all-technique transfer. Paid service is not guaranteed gain; a quote is not consent/settlement. Particular alchemy accidents, crystal splitting and potion reuse consequences cannot define all crafting. Rooms, invitations, stored stock and carrier/return rights differ; hub protection is not universal invulnerability. Preserve meaningful comfort, leisure, companion refusal/pocket money, local staff motives and paid support beside combat.

F6: Honor Shop stock rules/refresh/mission summoning are era/shop-level specific; Abyss shop is a different authority/currency/access and hidden-credit channel. Lottery first-free/tenfold/restart price does not fix every shop or justify new anti-exploit gates. Title forging and earned status are not universal counters. Existing source-hub, independent-Goa and original Exchange are separate profiles; a contractor, native, employee, Hunter and nonhuman visitor need actual rights/body/clock contracts. Current PROJECT governs ordering; this historical multi-pass suggestion launches no new world/readers. Fold useful service/quote/custody, rights-and-duties, local consequence and clock distinctions into actual Paradise owners. No new runtime/source-code/build/browser/save/human proof, acquisition, worker, deletion/move, commit or push occurs.
reviews.evidence: Both complete docs read in bounded untruncated ranges; derived owner118–140/260–277 and hub owner1–30 scoped. Literal row arithmetic only, no new novel bodies/runtime proof.
reviews.reopen: Keep source-local unknowns and inspect applicable current seams for a selected authorized slice, preserving old compatibility and optional human review.

reviews.classification: multi-round source scope, local rights and optional human review reconciled
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers253input lines, F01–F33 including F20a grade cards/PD-SYS046–061, D01–D04, all32SRPstarts,10ARPvariants,12CRPcapabilities,eightVRPgates,fiveAsuggestions and current planning boundary. The supplied PD-MTL67f15d112389snapshot/4656members/4505distinctbodies/151duplicates and missing printed4042–4049 are inherited dossier limits, not a fresh full source read. Selected source claims/primary opening/dossier/typed recheck flags remain different evidence levels. No raw novel body or runtime source consumer was newly inspected here; F25–F32 are dated source-reading statements, not renewed current claims.

F2: Keep original Exchange, independent voluntary Village/Goa traveler, new source-contractor start, Su Xiao’s seat, local native and rival institution distinct. Existing optional survey credit/90minute/two-minute/extraction/frozen-absence values are prototype meanings, not canon. Particular source coercion, failure,30secondreturn, employee testimony, ordinary origin suppression and body-specific exceptions require their actual source/era. A later canon slice cannot silently rename or overwrite existing contracts, actor history, money or saved branch. The current-boundary paragraph’s recorded reset/drop compatibility choice remains qualified; no migration is performed by this document.

F3: SRP1–SRP32remain authored proposals/C-AU-Uadmission variants, not selectable starts. Same named actor/body cannot duplicate through a rarity roll. Relationship, office, source faculty, body slots, custody, knowledge and actual permissions are separate. Nonhuman existence is not contractor eligibility; playing a companion does not grant its canon powers. Native survival/support and origin-world acquaintance retain their own lives. ARP1–ARP10are bounded variation options, not mandatory launch scope or universal fork machinery. Avoid deriving full rival Paradise identity from translated aliases; retain event-specific notary and source-cutoff/recheck gaps.

F4: CRP1–CRP12are a capability palette with dependencies, not a prerequisite to building all institutions/body types/worlds/currencies. CostS/M/Lis proposal-relative to the inspected seam and selected slice, not a measured estimate today. Source-tier bands, graded card ratings/overlaps, point conversion, soul crystal grades, actual fuel, personal faculty and current masteries cannot collapse into a shared power number. The later facility/institution pass supplies selected prices/rights and derives original/MTL limits, but does not close every recheck or prove current runtime. Actual shared producers/state/consumers must be inspected for any chosen implementation.

F5: Proposed SRP2 room/guide/training/preparation journey has meaningful paid/refused routes, conserved custody, actual follow-on effect and persistence compatibility checks. Keep those selected verification ideas without turning full AU/nextmission/three-viewport coverage into universal gates. Human review remains optional under AD42; the plan’s old mandatory final-human gate is retired. The one-realm/one-prestige wording is retired under current PROJECT while finish-one-playable-slice remains. AD43floor/source edit/test/build/native/persistence/human evidence stay separate. No present gameplay/build/browser/save/commit or changed priority follows from this reconciliation. Preserve exact open coercion/return, aliases, cutoffs, physiology and unsupported arbitrary interaction gaps.

folds.heading: ## Facility source and local-standing reconciliation B610
folds.body: The [facilities pass](../REINCARNATION_PARADISE_FACILITIES_AND_SUBTLE_DETAILS_2026-10-23.md#content-reconciliation-b610-facilities-local-currency-and-evidence-scope) reconciles its three rounds without upgrading keyword excerpts to full source reading. The existing local-board/hub-service split and corrected15000CPgene-liquid versus13000CPSmashingFairy/reference3800PC remain. Local contribution/merit wording, rank thresholds versus balance, Hunter office/shop level/tier, real refresh/leave clocks and negative standing versus debt are separate. F29’s school fee absence is unverified at coordinator level; no-price-found does not establish free tuition. No equivalent-mechanism absence, universal queue rule or new module is proven by literal scans. Designed secrets remain ID/route/status; public canon is not automatically a sealed new truth.

folds.heading: ## Later institution-pass scope reconciliation B610
folds.body: The [later facilities pass](../REINCARNATION_PARADISE_FACILITIES_AND_SUBTLE_DETAILS_2026-10-23.md#content-reconciliation-b610-facilities-local-currency-and-evidence-scope) extends era-specific fees, paid instruction/trials, tier duties, shop-level rights and local-world institutions. Its mixed snippets/selected checks do not freshly authenticate the MTL or establish all later services. Keep local money and actual conversion channel apart from Paradise balances; a negative Void Tree credit rating is not debt principal. Paid treatment consent, quote, work, actual result, custody and later usable effect remain distinct. Rooms/comfort/social work can stay useful without mandatory copied tariffs or a universal source cap. The [canon plan](CANON_PRIORITY_PLAN_2026-10-14.md#content-reconciliation-b610-starts-capability-palette-and-proof) remains a proposal governed by current PROJECT/AD42, not a requirement to finish all starts/worlds or obtain a human gate.
